name: ExpertZZLWA
summary: ExpertZZLWA is a trend-following Expert Advisor that utilizes the ZZLWA (ZigZag Linear Weighted Average) indicator to identify market reversals and trend direction. It enters trades when the ZigZag-based weighted average confirms a new trend direction, aiming to capture significant trend movements. The EA applies systematic entry and exit rules based on the ZZLWA signal transitions.
summary_zh: ExpertZZLWA是一个基于ZZLWA（ZigZag线性加权平均）指标的趋势跟踪型EA，通过识别市场反转和趋势方向进行交易。当ZigZag加权平均确认新趋势方向时开仓，旨在捕捉显著的趋势行情。该EA基于ZZLWA信号转换应用系统化的入场和出场规则。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的策略核心是利用ZigZag线性加权平均指标来识别趋势的转折点，当指标方向从下行转为上行时做多，从上行转为下行时做空。入场条件依赖于ZZLWA指标的方向翻转信号，属于典型的趋势跟踪策略，追求捕捉中长线趋势利润。出场条件通常包括固定止盈止损或指标反向信号平仓，确保每笔交易都有明确的风险控制。仓位管理方面，EA允许用户自定义手数或采用基于资金比例的动态仓位计算方式。资金管理方面，建议配合合理的风险比例设置，避免单笔交易过度暴露风险，但需注意趋势跟踪策略在震荡市中可能频繁止损。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA relies on the ZigZag Linear Weighted Average (ZZLWA) indicator to identify trend reversal points, going long when the indicator direction shifts from downward to upward and going short when it shifts from upward to downward. Entry conditions depend on the ZZLWA indicator direction flip signal, representing a classic trend-following approach aimed at capturing medium-to-long-term trend profits. Exit conditions typically include fixed take-profit and stop-loss levels or closing positions on opposite indicator signals, ensuring each trade has defined risk controls. Position sizing allows the user to customize lot sizes or employ dynamic position calculation based on account equity percentage. Money management should incorporate reasonable risk ratio settings to avoid excessive exposure on any single trade, though trend-following strategies may suffer frequent stop-outs during ranging markets.

pros: 基于ZigZaw加权平均的趋势识别逻辑清晰，信号明确
设有固定止损止盈参数，具备基本风险控制
系统化交易规则，避免情绪化决策
支持自定义手数和移动止损，灵活性较好
pros_en: Clear trend identification logic based on ZigZag weighted average with unambiguous signals
Includes fixed stop-loss and take-profit parameters for basic risk control
Systematic trading rules that eliminate emotional decision-making
Supports customizable lot sizes and trailing stop for good flexibility
cons: 趋势跟踪策略在震荡行情中容易频繁止损
缺乏市场状态过滤机制，无法区分趋势和震荡市
未内置仓位比例计算，可能存在过度交易风险
ZigZag指标存在重绘问题，历史信号可能不准确
cons_en: Trend-following strategy prone to frequent stop-outs in ranging/sideways markets
Lacks market regime filter to distinguish trending from ranging conditions
No built-in proportional position sizing, potentially leading to overtrading risk
ZigZag indicator has repainting issues, making historical signals potentially unreliable
improvements: 增加市场状态过滤器（如ADX或波动率指标），避免在震荡市中频繁交易
加入基于账户资金的动态仓位管理，按风险比例自动计算手数
增加时间过滤和点差过滤，避免在不利时段交易
improvements_en: Add a market regime filter (e.g., ADX or volatility indicator) to avoid frequent trading in ranging markets
Implement dynamic position sizing based on account equity, automatically calculating lot size by risk percentage
Add time and spread filters to avoid trading during unfavorable sessions or high-spread conditions

risk_points: ZigZag指标存在重绘特性，实盘信号可能与回测不一致
缺乏震荡市过滤机制，横盘行情中可能连续亏损
未强制要求设置止损，用户可能遗漏止损参数
risk_points_en: ZigZag indicator has repainting characteristics, live signals may differ from backtest results
Lacks ranging market filter, consecutive losses possible during sideways conditions
Stop-loss not enforced as mandatory, users may omit stop-loss parameter
